// diagnostic

E3112

This `#Unsafe` block/function has no reason.

What

This `#Unsafe` block/function has no reason.

Why

Every gated region/function must record why it cannot break memory safety; the audit sentence is mandatory.

Fix

add the reason: `#Unsafe("why this is safe") { … }` or `#Unsafe("why this is safe") fn ...`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3112: tests/ui/unsafe_fn_missing_reason.stderr.

Error [E3112]: an `#Unsafe` function needs a reason
  --> tests/ui/unsafe_fn_missing_reason.jet:3:1
    |
  3 | #Unsafe fn unchecked_answer() => Int {
    | ^^^^^^^
 Why: every unsafe function records why callers can rely on its unchecked contract
 Fix: write `#Unsafe("why this is safe") fn …`
